comment: Reviewed false positives of tools/check-transcripts.py: tool calls whose text matched a forbidden-material rule but did not open, fetch or search that material. Each entry names the exact session and tool call. Added only by pull request; the owner's signed merge approves it.

reviewed.reason: A shell command that only wrote commit-message text files (cat > file <<EOF) into the session's scratch folder, then committed. The text describes the clean folder's sparse checkout, which leaves out vendor/emulator/ and harness/. Neither folder exists in the repository; nothing was opened or listed.
The same command: commit-message text mentioning harness/ (the sparse-checkout exclusion, and the checker's own pattern fix). Neither folder exists in the repository; nothing was opened or listed.

`git sparse-checkout set` with patterns that leave vendor/emulator/, harness/ and sessions/spec/ out of the clean folder's checkout. It names the folders only to exclude them; nothing was opened, listed or fetched.
